notes.title: Release Notes for 20/04/2024
notes.content:

notes.title: Release Notes for 19/04/2024
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Items:[/b] Resolved an issue where temporary bonus items were not being removed as intended.
[*] [b]Balance:[/b] Fixed an issue that allowed damage received from enemies to be entirely negated.
[*] [b]Controller:[/b] Fixed an issue that interfered with purchasing weapon attachments using a controller.
[*] [b]Stabiltiy:[/b] Performance improvements on Muspelheim.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 18/04/2024
notes.content:
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Damage:[/b] Damage received from enemies has been adjusted.
[*] [b]Health Rune:[/b] Now restores health for every 5 enemies killed instead of 2.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	[b]Bosses:[/b] Fixed an issue where boss fights would not initiate after the fourth encounter.
[*] 	[b]Rage Mode:[/b] Fixed an issue where players remained stuck in Rage Mode even after its duration had expired.
[*] 	[b]Controller:[/b] Fixed a bug that interfered with performing Glory Kills using a controller.
[*] 	[b]Dungeon Rewards:[/b] Players no longer lose rewards for the last cleared dungeon upon giving up. [i](Does not apply to Nightmare mode)[/i]
[*] 	[b]Rune Badge:[/b] Fixed an issue that prevented acquired Rune Badges from being saved.
[*] 	[b]Audio:[/b] Fixed an issue that prevented audio settings from being saved.
[*] 	[b]Language:[/b] Fixed texts with missing localization settings.
[*] 	[b]Stability:[/b] Memory improvements to reduce crash problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes 17/04/2024
notes.content:
[h3]User Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a splash screen and a photosensitivity warning for safety.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Adjustments to Great Sword:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased attack range to improve combat reach.
[*] Decreased recovery time for the last combo attack to enhance responsiveness.
[*] Dash-Attack now includes a slight knock-back effect.
[/list][i]Overall, these changes aim to make the weapon feel less sluggish.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rage Mode:[/b] Fixed an issue where players remained stuck in Rage Mode after switching maps.
[*] [b]Dialogues:[/b] Fixed an issue that prevented some dialogues from playing.
[*] [b]Save Slots:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused save slots to display [i]"Unknown"[/i] as the location.
[*] [b]Ultimate Badges:[/b] Reintroduced a previously removed badge after fixing underlying functionality issues.
[*] [b]Maps:[/b] Made collision and layout adjustments to certain maps for smoother navigation.
[*] [b]Stability:[/b] Made memory improvements to reduce crash problems.
[/list]
